title: Live hardware and native control transport
objective: Add independent low-latency TUI hardware sampling and replace the native temporary control mailbox with authenticated bounded loopback TCP.
constraints: Treat every downloaded and locally available model as part of the stack.
Do not append high-frequency presentation samples to the durable run ledger.
Bind native control transport to loopback only.
Keep leaf_loop_inlet.py authoritative for state changes.
Never expose or persist private chain-of-thought.
acceptance: Both TUI renderers display independently refreshed hardware counters and sample age.
The fast collector does not invoke the disk probe.
Native controls require a per-session token over a bounded loopback socket.
Only pause_toggle, approve, and stop reach the inlet controller.
Control transport health is present in the normalized snapshot.
All automated and live verification passes.
